bullets: Trump said Sunday morning on social media that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an 'ENERGY CEASEFIRE ... Effective immediately' — 'Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!' The announcement came days after his Friday call with Putin and the controversial Russian diesel-supply deal.

Zelensky told ABC News earlier Sunday he is open to it: 'OK, if they want energy ceasefire, we are open for this ... We will stop attack your diesel. And I think it's fair, fair deal.' CNN notes there is no immediate confirmation from Moscow or Kyiv on the agreement itself — treat as unilateral announcement until verified.

The thread logic: Trump's Saturday comments blamed Zelenskyy for driving up global energy prices via refinery strikes and framed the Russian diesel deal as the response; an energy ceasefire would stop the tit-for-tat on energy infrastructure. Next: independent confirmation from Russia/Ukraine + the Sunday 5pm CT oil open (Brent closed Fri ~$104.72) — a genuine ceasefire would undercut the refinery-strike war premium on diesel and soften the crude bid.

GACA finalized the toll: 12 dead (4 Saudis, 2 Bangladeshis, and one national each from the US, Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Palestine and Sudan) and 309 wounded — the deadliest Gulf attack of the war. Fourth airport strike in a week, following the Thursday hit that killed 3 including a Saudia pilot.
